_comment: Image signing policy (#385) — the per-image cosign identity the deploy gate (scripts/verify_images.sh, called from deploy-on-merge.yml / deploy.yml) enforces before a deploy proceeds. Each deployed ECS image is resolved tag -> @sha256 digest and cosign-verified against its identity_regexp + issuer; the SBOM attestation (.att) is verified when require_attestation is true. The gate fails closed. This file is account-free on purpose (the ECR registry is derived at runtime from sts:GetCallerIdentity) so the public sparc-iac-template mirror stays uniform. To rotate/add a signer, edit this file — see docs/dev/image_signing_gate.md.
